name: Negative control (web): open pages incl. robots.txt, no crawl (no T1595.002 detection)
description: ZAP requests a fixed list of pages one per second, the way a person opens them: the home page, robots.txt and sitemap.xml. It never runs the spider and never follows a link. Ground truth: NOT scanning; a qualifying T1595.002 detection is a false positive. It sits next to the crawl rules on purpose: it reads the same files a crawler reads.
